method: Each local file was SHA256-checked against FILE_INVENTORY (except the two self-referential manifests, checked separately). The remote recursive Git tree was untruncated and its exact paths, blob object IDs and sizes matched the expected objects computed from those same local bytes. Git blob IDs cryptographically identify byte contents. This was a content-addressed verification, not a second SHA256 calculation over individually downloaded remote files.
raw_data: 186 data/raw files excluded from Git and included in full Plan B ZIP
